title: Step 58-F state errors loading and offline recovery foundation
description: Implement only the shared storefront async-state foundation: loading/refresh context preservation, empty-state vocabulary, sanitized public problems, browser connectivity hint, bounded recovery planning and accessible Persian StatePanel presentation. No feature loaders, global business state/cache, optimistic mutation, offline mutation queue, auth changes, backend/OpenAPI/database mutation, Stage G or Step59.

dependencies.name: Stage 58-E auth session and security boundary

acceptance_criteria.description: Runtime state vocabulary covers initial/progressive/refresh loading, ready, first-use/filtered/no-result empty, error, forbidden, offline and recovery without introducing business-state authority.
Public error presentation omits raw backend/transport messages and retains only minimal problem metadata such as kind, status, request-id and retryability.
Browser online/offline is represented only as a tri-state connectivity hint with unknown SSR snapshot and never as backend-health authority.

Recovery planning has no timer, polling or automatic UI retry; safe GET/HEAD may expose manual retry, mutations never auto-retry, and unknown mutation status-check requires an explicitly available authoritative capability.

Accessible Persian StatePanel supports Loading/Empty/Error/Forbidden/Offline/Recovery with logical RTL, aria status/busy semantics, bidi-isolated request-id and 44px actions without inventing an action when none is supplied.

Deterministic verification proves state models, previous-context preservation, sanitized problems, retry boundaries, offline distinction, presentation semantics and Step55 vocabulary trace while shell/API/auth/root verification stays green.

No feature loader, global business cache/state, optimistic mutation, offline mutation queue/service worker, auth change, backend/OpenAPI/database mutation, Stage G or Step59 implementation enters Stage F.
Canonical closure requires exact-artifact REVIEW/LOCK, exact-head verify/phase-a/merge-policy, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification before Stage G.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage F is MEDIUM risk. Stage G and Step59 remain forbidden until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
